description: This file declares utility functions for handling file paths and URLs, including conversion between file paths and file URLs, filename suggestion and generation, path safety validation, and reserved name checks, primarily for use within the Chromium project.

classes.name: GURL
classes.description: Represents a URL, used here for URL validation and conversion.

classes.name: base::FilePath
classes.description: Represents a filesystem path, used for path validation and manipulation.

methods.name: FilePathToFileURL
methods.description: Converts a filesystem path to a file: URL.

methods.name: FileURLToFilePath
methods.description: Converts a file: URL back to a filesystem path.

methods.name: GetSuggestedFilename
methods.description: Generates a suggested filename based on URL, headers, and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateFileName
methods.description: Returns a filename as a FilePath object based on URL and other parameters.

methods.name: GenerateFileName (overload)
methods.description: Returns a filename as a FilePath, with optional extension replacement based on MIME type.

methods.name: IsSafePortablePathComponent
methods.description: Checks if a path component is safe for filesystem use.

methods.name: IsSafePortableRelativePath
methods.description: Checks if a relative path is safe for filesystem use.

methods.name: GenerateSafeFileName
methods.description: Ensures filename and extension are safe for filesystem use, modifying as necessary.

methods.name: IsReservedNameOnWindows
methods.description: Checks if a filename is reserved on Windows.
